title: Title Desk Guidance: Receiving the Title on Trade-In Agreements
content:
The title requirement on a vehicle traded under **Trade-In Agreements** is completed only by an accepted title document, received at pickup or from the lienholder or the customer afterwards.

**Unliened vehicles.** A vehicle without a lien is picked up only with its signed paper title when the grade requires it.

**Liened vehicles.** For a liened vehicle, Kestrel waits up to the lien release wait days after sending the payoff for the lienholder's paper title or electronic lien release; after that the customer is asked for a lien release letter or, when the title was lost, a duplicate title.

**Completing documents.** Only the accepted title documents complete the title requirement, and the title received date is recorded on the agreement when the first of them arrives.

**Counting the chargeback period.** The chargeback period is counted in calendar days with the pickup date as day 0 and the chargeback is allowed from the day after its last day. A title-delay chargeback, once taken, is reversed by nothing under Trade-In Agreements.

| Day counted from the pickup date (day 0), with the period written as P | Position in the period |
|---|---|
| Day P | Last day of the period |
| Day P plus one | First day the chargeback is allowed |

*Hypothetical example:* with P of 45 and a pickup on day 0, day 45 is the last day of the period and day 46 is the first day a chargeback is allowed.

**Clauses no longer in force.** The following clauses of this guidance are **no longer in force** and are superseded by the current basis:

- "A title-delay chargeback may be taken only after the title delay chargeback days counted from the pickup date have passed with no title received date."
- "The chargeback is the grade's chargeback percentage of the value credited, deducted as a title-delay chargeback entry."
- The closing words "and the customer then owes the resulting shortfall within the chargeback payment days."

## Title paper by situation

| Situation | Paper that completes the requirement |
|---|---|
| No lien, grade requires the title at pickup | Signed paper title handed over at pickup |
| Lien paid, within the wait after the payoff was sent | Lienholder's paper title or electronic lien release |
| Lien paid, wait over | Lien release letter from the customer, or a duplicate title when the title was lost |

The title received date is the date the first accepted document arrives; later documents do not move it.

superseded_clauses: A title-delay chargeback may be taken only after the title delay chargeback days counted from the pickup date have passed with no title received date.
The chargeback is the grade's chargeback percentage of the value credited, deducted as a title_delay_chargeback entry;
